{"consolidated_memory":"PARTIAL UPLOAD ISSUES IN storage/blob/uploader.rs — THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS

All three incidents manifested as partial upload failures in the same component (storage/blob/uploader.rs, storage side), with identical repro (upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link) and signal (final part never gets acknowledged), but three distinct root causes and solutions.

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-24]
- Trigger: Only affected sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Outcome: 27 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #3766, branch fix/partial-upload-1

OCCASION 2: [2026-06-03]
- Trigger: Only appeared after client had already retried once
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Outcome: Flaky test went from 8 failures per 100 runs to zero
- Fix: Invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- PR #8534, branch fix/partial-upload-3

OCCASION 3: [2026-07-03]
- Trigger: Only occurred when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Outcome: Reclaimed 47 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #9586, branch fix/partial-upload-4

CONTEXT: Same corner of storage/blob/uploader.rs as earlier partial upload work, so context carried over across all three incidents."}
